svg.title: Linux x64: peak resident memory, warm
svg.desc: Linux x64: peak resident memory, warm. peak resident memory: the complexity pack (8 rules at the new version, 8 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 348 MB, 0.1.5 333 MB; peak resident memory: the javascript pack (121 rules at the new version, 121 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 853 MB, 0.1.5 1,231 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 1 core pinned (RERAIL_THREADS=1), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 538 MB, 0.1.5 600 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 642 MB, 0.1.5 631 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a larger corpus: the rerail-repository corpus of the bar (conformance, packs, scripts, src, test: 2,312 files), 3 runs a side: New version 763 MB, 0.1.5 689 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a smaller corpus: src/ of the same commit with package.json and tsconfig.json (226 files), 3 runs a side: New version 634 MB, 0.1.5 612 MB; peak resident memory: the node pack (37 rules at the new version, 37 at 0.1.5) on real code, 8 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=8), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 759 MB, 0.1.5 633 MB; peak resident memory: the rerail pack (34 rules at the new version, 34 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 494 MB, 0.1.5 496 MB; peak resident memory: the rust pack (33 rules at the new version, 33 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 476 MB, 0.1.5 491 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 1 core pinned (RERAIL_THREADS=1), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 479 MB, 0.1.5 517 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned (one thread per core, RERAIL_THREADS=4), 3 runs a side taken in turn: New version 595 MB, 0.1.5 575 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a larger corpus: the rerail-repository corpus of the bar (conformance, packs, scripts, src, test: 2,312 files), 3 runs a side: New version 666 MB, 0.1.5 716 MB; peak resident memory: the typescript pack (65 rules at the new version, 65 at 0.1.5) on real code, 4 cores pinned; a smaller corpus: src/ of the same commit with package.json and tsconfig.json (226 files), 3 runs a side: New version 586 MB, 0.1.5 491 MB;
